# Dependency provenance

## Akash node adapters

Read-only adapters are adapted from [`akash-network/node` at `4373aa9206deedc34abca3fe2574ea4ad9b1506d`](https://github.com/akash-network/node/tree/4373aa9206deedc34abca3fe2574ea4ad9b1506d/contracts/solana). Its Apache-2.0 license is retained in `NODE-LICENSE`.

| Local file | Original precedent |
| --- | --- |
| `reconcile.ts`, `reconcile-policy.ts` | `contracts/solana/local/reconcile.ts`, `reconcile-policy.ts` |
| `akash.ts` | `contracts/solana/reporter/akash.ts` |
| `id.ts` | `contracts/solana/shared/id.ts` |
| `proof.ts` | `contracts/solana/shared/proof.ts` and identity helpers |
| `reporter-policy.ts` | `contracts/solana/reporter/policy.ts` |
| `open-transfers.ts` | `contracts/solana/local/open-transfers.ts` |
| `durable.ts`, `client-status.ts`, `common.ts` | Corresponding `contracts/solana/local/` helpers |

Changes remove signing/local-stack setup and unused writer paths, move imports into this standalone package, and expose records and outcomes for the monitor. `src/policy.ts` owns alert severity and timers. Existing node code was not modified. Monitor APIs receive public identities and read-only RPC connections; no `AnchorProvider` wallet, ceremony key or signer is supplied.

## Mainnet program interfaces

`idl/` contains the existing generated mainnet AKT and ICS07 JSON interfaces and TypeScript types from node commit `40f916e337a0bc53dbf5fa2c95a51eb51b5f1ecd`, as recorded with exact source paths in `artifacts.json`. They were copied byte-for-byte, not hand-edited or regenerated by the monitor. The initially inspected operator interfaces had generic deployment addresses; comparison confirmed their account layouts, discriminators and arguments matched, with only addresses/PDA constants differing. The bundled files use the actual mainnet identities.

IDL discriminator arrays and PDA seed arrays are public instruction/account definitions, not private keypairs. No program binaries or keypair files are included.

## TypeScript chain SDK

`chain-sdk.tgz` is the generated TypeScript SDK built from public repository [`akash-network/chain-sdk`](https://github.com/akash-network/chain-sdk/tree/4a0ecebbe398763b1e329d72ce24e05b36676624), tag `go/v0.5.0-rc2`, commit `4a0ecebbe398763b1e329d72ce24e05b36676624`. Package version remains upstream's `1.0.0-alpha.46`.

The published npm package with that version does not contain these Sink types. Do not replace the local archive dependency with the registry version. This is why the archive and npm integrity lock are part of this standalone repository.

The archive was independently rebuilt from that public tag with Node 24.22.1. All 2,170 file contents matched; with the documented `umask 022` its entire compressed archive matched:

```text
dd79a66e040eaf45bff0ab768593fb12644841748a7ccb1e10d72ceefbb43334
```

Reproduction, from the repository root (writes disposable sources under `.cache` and leaves the bundled archive untouched):

```sh
(
  set -eu
  umask 022
  mkdir -p .cache
  task_dir=$(mktemp -d "$PWD/.cache/sdk-verify.XXXXXX")
  trap 'rm -rf "$task_dir"' EXIT
  expected="$PWD/vendor/chain-sdk.tgz"
  git clone --depth 1 --branch go/v0.5.0-rc2 \
    https://github.com/akash-network/chain-sdk.git "$task_dir/source"
  test "$(git -C "$task_dir/source" rev-parse HEAD)" = 4a0ecebbe398763b1e329d72ce24e05b36676624
  cd "$task_dir/source/ts"
  npm ci --ignore-scripts
  npm run build
  rm dist/tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo
  archive=$(npm pack --ignore-scripts --silent --pack-destination "$task_dir")
  cmp "$expected" "$task_dir/$archive"
)
```

Generated SDK package contents are restricted to `dist/`, `package.json`, README and LICENSE. The SDK's own license is included inside the archive. `npm run verify:vendor` checks the exact archive and IDL hashes. Build-tool caches owned by npm/esbuild are separate from this repository's source scratch directories.

## BME monitoring precedent

Reviewed [`chainzero/akash-bme-monitor` at `cbd2796d5a0287ffa3069c5219317ec314e8a41a`](https://github.com/chainzero/akash-bme-monitor/tree/cbd2796d5a0287ffa3069c5219317ec314e8a41a): alerting, monitor separation, RPC fallback, deployment and operations docs. Monitoring conventions are ported into TypeScript; no Go source or BME deployment resources are copied. The reference has no declared license. See `docs/devops-handoff.md` for the operational pattern and the additions required for durable bridge accounting.

## Known transitive advisories

The final application dependency audit reports 12 affected package entries: 7 moderate, 5 high, zero critical. These include parent packages affected by transitive advisories. This is **not** a zero-advisory dependency tree. The following scoped dispositions follow node's operator release review and need reassessment if dependencies or call paths change:

| Package | Advisory IDs | Current monitor path |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bigint-buffer | GHSA-3gc7-fjrx-p6mg | Install scripts disabled; vulnerable native binding absent and rejected by `verify:vendor`; JS fallback used. |
| toml | GHSA-82x6-q7mm-w9cf, GHSA-v5mp-jgw5-2x6j, GHSA-4qx8-w7c3-pj3p, GHSA-9j65-hcg3-gc64, GHSA-9qmh-m7c6-f92p | Anchor TOML workspace loading is unused; programs use bundled JSON IDLs. |
| stream-json | GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x, GHSA-hqr4-qq8f-hg3x, GHSA-mjw6-4jj6-33hc | Uses web3's HTTP client, not streaming servers/filters/assemblers. |
| uuid | GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq | Jayson HTTP request IDs use v4, not affected caller-supplied v3/v5/v6 buffers. |

Zod is pinned to patched version 4.6.7. Do not use `npm audit fix --force` without reviewing SDK/Anchor compatibility. The native-bindings fallback warning at startup is expected with this install policy; do not run a native rebuild to remove it. Dependency upgrades and a Linux image qualification remain part of production review.
